purpose: Give a personal reason with an explanatory or apologetic tone.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain form + もので; N / な-adjective + なもので
The roads were busy, so I was late.
It is my first time, so please explain the procedure.
My child is asleep, so please speak quietly.
formation: Plain form + もので; N / な-adjective + なもので
restrictions: Often explains the speaker’s own circumstances.
mistake: It can sound like an excuse; avoid using it as an impersonal proof.
